jobs.title: Creative Director(Content Strategist)
jobs.description:
We’re seeking an experienced Creative Manager with a strong agency background and established creative networks across Dubai and India.

The ideal candidate will have experience collaborating with international agencies, managing creative partnerships and leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality campaigns across markets.

Key Responsibilities

\* Lead creative strategy, campaign development and execution across multiple projects.

\* Manage creative teams and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners.

\* Build and maintain relationships with creative, branding, advertising and digital agencies in Dubai and India, as well as international markets.

\* Identify and manage external agency partnerships to support creative delivery and business objectives.

\* Ensure consistency in brand identity, creative quality and campaign execution.

\* Oversee project timelines, budgets, resources and deliverables.

\* Translate business requirements into impactful creative solutions for diverse audiences.

Requirements

\* Proven experience as a Creative Manager or in a comparable creative leadership position.

\* Strong background in a creative, advertising, branding or digital agency.

\* Demonstrated experience managing creative teams and external agency relationships.

\* Existing professional networks across Dubai and India; international agency exposure is a strong advantage.

\* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative strategy, campaign delivery and brand development.

\* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and organisational skills.

Who We’re Looking For

A commercially aware creative professional who can bridge creative talent, agency partnerships and business objectives across markets.

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience taking an idea from inception to execution?
* What is your salary expectation ?
* Are you willing to relocate to Dubai ?

Experience:

* Content creation: 3 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 100% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Native Creative Strategist - EdTech (French fluent )
jobs.description:
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep

jobs.title: Regional Creative Director – Middle East & Southeast Asia
jobs.description:
We are seeking an accomplished Regional Creative Director to lead creative strategy, concept development, and execution of regional brand campaigns, product launches, and brand experiences across the Middle East and Southeast Asia.

The ideal candidate must have experience with an international 4A advertising agency or equivalent global creative agency network, with a proven track record of personally leading campaigns from concept development to final execution.

The role requires strong creative leadership, hands-on involvement in copywriting and art direction, excellent English presentation skills, and the ability to deliver high-quality creative work across multiple markets and platforms.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead creative development of campaign concepts, brand narratives, messaging, and visual direction across regional markets.
* Translate business briefs and audience insights into original, impactful creative ideas adaptable across film, key visuals, digital, social media, and live experiences.
* Lead and guide copywriters, art directors, designers, and production teams in developing scripts, storyboards, visual concepts, and campaign assets.
* Provide hands-on creative input, constructive feedback, and quality control throughout concept development and execution.
* Prepare and deliver creative presentations in English, confidently pitching ideas and justifying creative decisions to clients and senior management.
* Collaborate with directors, photographers, design studios, and production partners, reviewing treatments, casting, shoots, edits, and post-production.
* Oversee creative adaptation across Middle Eastern and Southeast Asian markets while maintaining brand consistency and cultural relevance.
* Manage creative quality, production timelines, and execution standards within agreed budgets.
* Mentor creative teams, develop talent, and establish high standards for creative thinking, storytelling, and execution.

Mandatory Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Advertising, Marketing, Design, Communications, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of professional experience in advertising, brand creative, or integrated creative communications.
* **Mandatory: Previous experience working at an international 4A advertising agency or an equivalent global creative agency network.**
* Proven experience serving as the creative lead on campaigns that have been successfully launched or executed.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary creative teams, including copywriters, art directors, and designers.
* Strong portfolio showcasing original concepts, creative storytelling, brand campaigns, and high-quality execution.
* Ability to lead both copywriting and art direction disciplines, irrespective of primary professional background.
* Excellent English proficiency as a working language, with the ability to independently develop concepts, review scripts and copy, pitch creative ideas, and lead production discussions.
* Strong understanding of film, print, digital, and experiential production processes.
* Ability to manage creative quality while balancing production timelines, technical requirements, and budgets.
* Willingness to travel across the Middle East and Southeast Asia as required.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in automotive, mobility, premium consumer goods, or technology industries.
* Experience leading regional product launches and integrated brand campaigns.
* Exposure to experiential marketing, live events, and large-scale brand activations.
* Familiarity with Middle Eastern and Southeast Asian consumer markets, cultures, and creative requirements.

Application Requirements

Candidates must submit:

* Updated English-language CV.
* Portfolio link showcasing relevant creative work.
* Three key campaign case studies demonstrating:
* Core creative idea and campaign objective.
* Individual role and creative contribution.
* Markets covered.
* Creative development and execution.
* Links to final campaign work, films, visuals, or event footage.

Candidates must clearly identify their personal contribution to each campaign, particularly where projects involved multidisciplinary teams.

**Selection Note:** International 4A agency or equivalent global creative agency experience, 10+ years of relevant experience, proven creative leadership on executed campaigns, a strong portfolio, and professional English communication skills are mandatory selection criteria.

Pay: AED10,000.00 - AED30,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* portfolio/Casestudy

Experience:

* Automotive marketing: 10 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 100% (Required)

Work Location: In person
